ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Last winter and this spring, strong sandstorms occurred many times in most areas of our country; billowing yellow sand crossed the Qinling Mountains and Daba Mountains, producing an obvious impact on the weather conditions of some cities in the Sichuan Basin. The following material is a statistical table of the frequency of strong sandstorms and the speed of land desertification in our country in the second half of the 20th century. <image1> The table shows that the speed of land desertification in our country continuously accelerated from the 1950s to the 1990s. What might this be due to?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The further deterioration of the ecological environment in the arid areas of Northwest China
